ety: สืบทอดจากไทดั้งเดิม *qaːtᴰ; ร่วมเชื้อสายกับปักษ์ใต้ ค้าด, ลาว ຂາດ (ขาด), ไทลื้อ ᦃᦱᧆ (ฃาด), ไทดำ ꪄꪱꪒ (ฃาด), ไทขาว ꪄꪱꪒ, ไทใหญ่ ၶၢတ်ႇ (ข่าต), อาหม 𑜁𑜞𑜄𑜫 (ขฺรต์), จ้วง kat

from: ไทดั้งเดิม

rule: ขาด runs in two branches off the cut. Sense 1 keeps everything where something is SEVERED, and Thai's whole vocabulary of finality sits there, because a thing cut through cannot be rejoined: ตัดขาด, เด็ดขาด, ชี้ขาด, ผูกขาด, ขายขาด, ขาดตัว, ขาดใจ. The LACKING branch (2) takes what ought to be present and is not — ขาดตลาด, ขาดแคลน. SHORTFALL (3) takes what is present but not in full — ขาดทุน, ขาดเหลือ. Sense 5 takes a shortfall measured against a stated number: เดือนขาด, the 29-day month against เดือนเต็ม.

notes.h2: 2026-09-19 — ขาด, ขอ, ลาย (43 filed, 3 tagged false-split, 2 toponyms homeless)
notes.text:
**Rule.** ขาด runs in two branches off the cut. Sense 1 keeps everything where
something is SEVERED, and Thai's whole vocabulary of finality sits there, because
a thing cut through cannot be rejoined: ตัดขาด, เด็ดขาด, ชี้ขาด, ผูกขาด, ขายขาด,
ขาดตัว, ขาดใจ, ขาดลอย, ฟิวส์ขาด. The LACKING branch (2) takes what ought to be
present and is not — ขาดตลาด, ขาดแคลน, คงขาด. SHORTFALL (3) takes what is present
but not in full — ขาดทุน, ขาดเหลือ. Sense 5 takes a shortfall measured against a
stated number: เดือนขาด, the 29-day month the RID itself pairs คู่กับ เดือนเต็ม.

notes.h2: 2026-09-19 — ขาด, ขอ, ลาย (43 filed, 3 tagged false-split, 2 toponyms homeless)
notes.text:
Senses 4 (ไม่ครบ, บกพร่อง) and 6 (ไม่มาตามกำหนด) took nothing. 6 is the school
register's ขาดเรียน and no such compound is in this list; 4 is a generalisation of
3 and every candidate read better at 3, which is the sense that says a thing is
held but not held in full.

notes.h2: 2026-09-19 — ขาด, ขอ, ลาย (43 filed, 3 tagged false-split, 2 toponyms homeless)
notes.text:
**Unsure — คงขาด, filed 2.** The gloss is bare ยังขาด. I read คง as no more than
"still" and filed the head's own plain sense, lacking. But คงขาด reads like a
ledger line beside คงเหลือ, and if that is where it lives it is a count short of
its number and belongs at 5, or at 3. Nothing on this disk says which; the RID
gives it two words and no example.

notes.h2: 2026-09-19 — ขาด, ขอ, ลาย (43 filed, 3 tagged false-split, 2 toponyms homeless)
notes.text:
**Unsure — ขาดทุน, filed 3.** ได้น้อยกว่าต้นทุน. Money is a number and 5 is the
numeric sense, but 5 is the RID's ไม่เต็มตามจำนวน — short of a *stated* count, as
เดือนขาด is short of thirty days. A loss is not short of a stated figure, it is a
capital not made whole, so 3.
